scope: Platform system-font Unicode cmap coverage. Generic fallback fonts such as Last Resort count by default because the platform renders a glyph for those code points.

sources.name: Unicode DerivedAge.txt
sources.coverage: Code point age ranges by Unicode version. Planned input for scalar Unicode coverage.

sources.name: Unicode emoji-test.txt
sources.coverage: RGI emoji sequences and emoji version labels. The extension ships a compact export as emoji_rgi.tsv.

sources.name: Microsoft Windows font lists
sources.coverage: Published Windows font file inventory. Use it to verify expected system font files, then scan C:\Windows\Fonts from a pinned Windows install for cmap ranges.

sources.name: Android system font inventory APIs and AOSP font configuration
sources.coverage: AOSP font configuration and Android guidance. Use emulator/system-image font files or Android SystemFonts APIs for actual installed-font coverage; OEM images may differ.

sources.name: Ubuntu desktop font package manifests
sources.coverage: Ubuntu desktop metapackage dependency list, including fonts-dejavu-core, fonts-liberation, fonts-noto-core, fonts-noto-cjk, fonts-noto-color-emoji, and fonts-ubuntu. Scan /usr/share/fonts in a pinned install for cmap ranges.

current.notes: Assume current iOS can render Unicode scalar fallback glyphs until a pinned iOS runtime/font bundle scan is available.
AOSP ships broad Noto/Roboto font fallback; assume scalar fallback coverage until a pinned emulator/system-image scan is available.
Windows publishes a base font inventory including Segoe UI, Segoe UI Emoji, Segoe UI Historic, and Segoe UI Symbol; assume scalar fallback coverage until a pinned Windows font scan is available.
Ubuntu desktop includes broad Noto, DejaVu, Liberation, Ubuntu, CJK, and color emoji font packages; assume scalar fallback coverage until a pinned Ubuntu image scan is available.
